questions.question: The Government of India has mandated the nationwide sale of E20 petrol (20% ethanol-blended petrol) with a minimum Research Octane Number (RON) of 95, effective from which date?
questions.solution:

__
 
• **Starting 1 April 2026, all petrol retail outlets across India must sell only E20 petrol, which is a blend of 80% gasoline and 20% ethanol.**
 
• The mandate also specifies a **minimum Research Octane Number (RON) of 95**, which is higher than the current standard, ensuring better engine performance.
 
• This move is a primary milestone under the **Ethanol Blending Programme (EBP)**, aimed at transitioning away from the current E10 (10% ethanol) standard.
 
• The policy applies to all **Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs)** and private players in the oil marketing sector.

 __
 
• A measure of a fuel's ability to resist "knocking" or "pinging" during combustion in an engine; a higher RON indicates higher fuel quality and efficiency.
 
 
 
• Ethanol Blending Programme (EBP)__
 __
 
• A government initiative to blend ethanol (derived from sugarcane, maize, etc.) with petrol to reduce crude oil imports and carbon emissions.
 
 
 
• Environmental Impact__
 __
 
• E20 fuel helps in reducing **carbon monoxide (CO)** and hydrocarbon emissions, contributing to India's climate goals and net-zero ambitions.

questions.question: Which of the following is not an Operating System?

• **Laptops, tablets**, and **desktop computers** all run **operating systems** that you've probably heard of. Some examples include versions of **Microsoft Windows** (like **Windows 10, Windows 8, Windows 7, Windows Vista, and Windows XP**),** Apple's macOS **(formerly **OS X**), **Chrome OS**, **BlackBerry Tablet OS**, and flavors of** Linux**, an **open-source operating system**. 
 
• Your computer's **operating system** (**OS**) manages all of the** software **and** hardware **on the computer. Most of the time, there are several different computer programs running at the same time, and they all need to access your computer's **central processing unit (CPU)**, **memory**, and **storage**. The operating system coordinates all of this to make sure each program gets what it needs.

questions.question: Average Monthly income of P and Q is Rs. 5,050. Average Monthly income of Q and R is Rs. 6,250.and average monthly income of P and R is Rs. 5,200. The monthly income of P is
questions.solution:
Given:

The average monthly income of:

P and Q = Rs. 5,050 

Q and R = Rs. 6,250

P and R = Rs. 5,200

Formula Used:

Average = Sum of the terms/Number of terms

Calculation:

**Total Monthly Income :**

⇒ P + Q = Rs.5,050 × 2 = Rs. 10,100 ----(1)

⇒ Q + R = Rs.6,250 × 2 = Rs. 12,500 ----(ii)

⇒ P + R = Rs.5,200 × 2 = Rs. 10,400 ----(iii)

∴ Adding equations (i), (ii) and (iii) we get,

⇒ 2(P + Q + R) = 10,100 + 12,500 + 10,400 = 33,000

⇒ P + Q + R = 33,000/2 = Rs. 16,500

∴ The monthly income of P = (P + Q + R) - (Q + R)

⇒ 16,500 - 12,500 = Rs. 4,000

∴ The monthly income of P is Rs. 4,000.

questions.question: The first network that initiated the internet was?
questions.solution:
The Internet has become a basic necessity in economic activities and it is deepening its roots in social activities too. The post–the globalized era of the 90s heralded an entirely new phase in the annals of human civilization with ICT getting a huge impetus as a consequence of the **Internet **taking rapid, brisk, and phenomenal strides, changing in the process the communication scenario the world over.

 
• How we have been communicating with each other and sources and means of locating information have constantly been changing from time to time. (Ahluwalia, 2011, p.11)
 
• The Internet is also simply known as **“the Net”** or **“the Web”** and can be briefly understood as **“a network of networks”**.
 
• It got its **birth out of fear in the Pentagon** for the **US military** wanted its researchers nationwide to share the sophisticated computers. 
 
• The roots of the internet were found in the year 1960 in a project namely **ARPANET (Advanced Research Projects Agency Network)** which was carried out by the Defense Department of the US Government.

**VNET:**

 
• It is an international computer networking system.
 
• **Started in the mid-1970s **and still currently use, but highly diminished.
 
• It was developed in IBM and provided the main email and file-transfer backbone for the company during the 1980s and 1990s. 

**ARPANET:**

 
• The Internet, then known as ARPANET, was **brought online in 1969** by the renamed Advanced Research Projects Agency (ARPA).
 
• The Arpanet used a technology, called Packet switching, which splits messages into tiny pieces to be further transmitted through different telephone routes to the desired destination.
 
• The Creator of the Internet Vinton G. Cerf describing it as “The sky is the limit” defined ARPANET as:
 
 
• “ARPAnet is a network of computers. The Internet is a network of networks. An interplanetary net would be a network of Internet.” - Vinton, G. Cerf.
 
 

**INET:**

 
• **It stands for "Internet networking".**
 
• It is considered as the leading event in the Internet industry.
 
• It provides an international platform for promoting the development and implementation of Internet networks, technologies, applications, and policies.

**NSFNet:**

 
• It stands for National Science Foundation Network. 
 
• It is a wide area network established by the NSF (National Science Foundation) in** 1986.**
 
• It was a pivotal pillar to ARPANET and the Internet during the late 1980s and early 1990s.
 
• In 1995, NSF pulled out the NSFNET from the Internet, though it continued as a separate network for supplementary research and development.

**In brief, ARPANET is the first network that was initiated by the internet. So, option 2 is correct.**

questions.question: A quadrilateral ABCD is inscribed in a circle such that the ∠ACD = 35∘ and base AB is diameter to the circle. Find ∠DAB.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since **AB** is the **diameter**, the angle subtended by it at the circumference is **∠ADB = 90°**.

Angles subtended by the same **chord AD** at different points on the circumference are equal: **∠ABD = ∠ACD = 35°**.

In **ΔABD**, sum of angles is 180°: **∠DAB = 180° − (90° + 35°) = 55°**.

**∴ The correct answer is 55°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Quadrilateral **ABCD** is inscribed in a circle (**cyclic quadrilateral**).

**∠ACD = 35°** and **AB** is the **diameter** of the circle.

**Formula Used:**

1. **Angle in a semicircle** is a **right angle** (90°).

2. **Angles in the same segment** of a circle are **equal**.

3. Sum of **interior angles of a triangle** is **180°**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8a918b8361d934e733c29f6954efc024fe82c9c066e5c846d9a98c187929943.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ In the circle, **AB** is the **diameter**.

⇒ According to the property of circles, the **angle subtended by the diameter** at any point on the circumference is **90°**.

⇒ ∴ **∠ADB = 90°**.

⇒ Also, **∠ABD** and **∠ACD** are **angles in the same segment** subtended by the **chord AD**.

⇒ ∴ **∠ABD = ∠ACD = 35°**.

⇒ In **ΔABD**, the sum of all angles is **180°**.

⇒ **∠DAB + ∠ABD + ∠ADB = 180°**

⇒ **∠DAB + 35° + 90° = 180°**

⇒ **∠DAB + 125° = 180°**

⇒ **∠DAB = 180° − 125°**

⇒ **∠DAB = 55°**.

**∴ The correct answer is 55°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cyclic Quadrilateral Properties

The sum of **opposite angles** of a cyclic quadrilateral is always **180°**. For ABCD, ∠A + ∠C = 180° and ∠B + ∠D = 180°.

Angles in the Same Segment

Angles subtended by the same **arc** or **chord** at the remaining part of the circle's circumference are **equal**.

Angle in a Semicircle

Thales's Theorem states that an angle subtended by a **diameter** at any point on the circumference is always a **right angle (90°)**.</p

questions.question: Let x be the largest 4-digit number which is divisible by each of 16, 21, 24 and 28. The sum of the digits of X is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The **LCM** of 16, 21, 24, and 28 is **336**.

Largest 4-digit number 9999 ÷ 336 leaves a **remainder** of 255.

Largest 4-digit multiple (x) = 9999 − 255 = **9744**.

Sum of digits of 9744 = 9 + 7 + 4 + 4 = **24**.

**∴ The correct answer is 24.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Divisors are **16, 21, 24, and 28**.

**Formula Used:** x = **Largest 4-digit number** − (Largest 4-digit number mod **LCM** of divisors).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/406e0f2c341db863f0eb7fe0181043ba2c485c362f8fb07382fd403899bee673.png] 

⇒ Prime factorization of 16 = 2⁴

⇒ Prime factorization of 21 = 3 × 7

⇒ Prime factorization of 24 = 2³ × 3

⇒ Prime factorization of 28 = 2² × 7

⇒ **LCM** = 2⁴ × 3 × 7 = 16 × 21 = **336**

⇒ **Largest 4-digit number** = 9999

⇒ 9999 ÷ 336 ⇒ Quotient = 29, Remainder = 255

⇒ Required number **x** = 9999 − 255 = **9744**

⇒ **Sum of digits** = 9 + 7 + 4 + 4 = **24**

**∴ The correct answer is 24.**

**__Additional Information__**

Least Common Multiple (LCM)

The **LCM** is the smallest positive integer that is exactly divisible by each of the given numbers. It is calculated by taking the highest power of each prime factor involved.

Divisibility Rule of 3

A number is divisible by **3** if the **sum of its digits** is a multiple of 3. Since 9744 is a multiple of 21 and 24, it must be divisible by 3.

Division Algorithm

For any dividend and divisor: **Dividend = (Divisor × Quotient) + Remainder**. To find the largest multiple below a limit, subtract the remainder from that limit.</p

questions.question: If 36 litres of 20% milk solution is mixed with 48 litres of 10% milk solution, then what will be the percentage concentration of milk in the final solution?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **quantities** = 36 : 48 = 3 : 4

Apply **weighted average** formula: (n₁c₁ + n₂c₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂)

Final concentration = (3 × 20% + 4 × 10%) ÷ (3 + 4)

Final concentration = (60 + 40) ÷ 7 = 100 ÷ 7 ≈ 14.28%

**∴ The correct answer is 14.28%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Volume 1** (V₁) = 36 litres, **Concentration 1** (C₁) = 20%

**Volume 2** (V₂) = 48 litres, **Concentration 2** (C₂) = 10%

**Formula Used:**

Total milk = (V₁ × C₁) + (V₂ × C₂)

Final Concentration % = (Total milk ÷ Total volume) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4d19315704c4bb3a8fb85c2069ffb61c666bc71cca77c37f0a1a4c471227f62.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Milk in solution 1 = 36 × (20 ÷ 100) = 7.2 litres

⇒ Milk in solution 2 = 48 × (10 ÷ 100) = 4.8 litres

⇒ Total milk in final solution = 7.2 + 4.8 = 12 litres

⇒ Total volume of final solution = 36 + 48 = 84 litres

⇒ Percentage concentration = (12 ÷ 84) × 100

⇒ Percentage concentration = (1 ÷ 7) × 100

⇒ Percentage concentration = 14.2857...

**∴ The correct answer is 14.28%.**

**__Additional Information__**

Alligation Rule

The ratio of the weights is inversely proportional to the differences between the concentrations: (n₁ ÷ n₂) = (c₂ − cₘ) ÷ (cₘ − c₁).

Weighted Average

When two groups with different averages are combined, the combined average is calculated as Aₐvg = (n₁a₁ + n₂a₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Fraction to Percentage Conversion

The fraction 1/7 is a common recurring decimal equal to 14.2857% or approximately 14.28%.</p

questions.question: A, B and C started a business by investing Rs. 10000 each. After 4 months A withdraws Rs. 3000 and B withdraws Rs. 4000 and C invests an additional Rs. 3000. The total profit at the end of the year is Rs.32800. Find the share of C in the profit.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Profit share ratio = (Capital × Time) for each partner.

A : B : C = (10 × 4 + 7 × 8) : (10 × 4 + 6 × 8) : (10 × 4 + 13 × 8)

A : B : C = 96 : 88 : 144 = 12 : 11 : 18

Total ratio = 41 units = **Rs. 32800** ⇒ 1 unit = **Rs. 800**

C's share = 18 × 800 = **Rs. 14400**

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 14400.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Initial investment of **A, B and C** = **Rs. 10000** each. Transactions occur after **4 months** for a total duration of **12 months**.

**Formula Used:** Profit Ratio = (Initial Capital × Time₁) + (Updated Capital × Time₂)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b6fc1216e1d2404908e7925c757c03c66e3ced48eb14aa1c9b8dd4da16b5621.png] 

⇒ **A's** share units = (10000 × 4) + (10000 − 3000) × 8 = 40000 + 56000 = **96000**

⇒ **B's** share units = (10000 × 4) + (10000 − 4000) × 8 = 40000 + 48000 = **88000**

⇒ **C's** share units = (10000 × 4) + (10000 + 3000) × 8 = 40000 + 104000 = **144000**

⇒ Profit Ratio (A : B : C) = 96000 : 88000 : 144000 = 12 : 11 : 18

⇒ Total profit = 12x + 11x + 18x = 41x

⇒ 41x = 32800 ⇒ x = 800

⇒ **C's** share = 18 × 800 = **Rs. 14400**

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 14400.**

**__Additional Information__**

Compound Partnership

When partners invest their capital for different time periods, the profit is distributed in the ratio of the products of their capital and time: P₁ : P₂ = (C₁ × T₁) : (C₂ × T₂).

Calculation of Capitals

If the profit ratio and time periods are known, the ratio of capitals can be found as C₁ : C₂ = (P₁/T₁) : (P₂/T₂).

Active and Sleeping Partner

An active partner is one who manages the business and usually receives a portion of the profit as salary before the remaining profit is divided based on investment ratios.</p

questions.question:
Two Statements S1 and S2 are given below followed by a Question:

S1 : There are not more than two figures on any page of a 51 - page book.

S2 : There is at least one figure on every page.

Question: Are there more than 100 figures in that book?

Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above Statements and the Question?

options.text: Both S1 and S2 are sufficient to answer the Question, but neither S1 alone nor S2 alone is sufficient to answer the Question.
S1 alone is sufficient to answer the Question.
S1 and S2 together are not sufficient to answer the Question.
2 alone is sufficient to answer the Question.

questions.solution:
**S1 : There are not more than two figures on any page of a 51 - page book.**

This means that there are 0, 1 or 2 figures on each page.

Maximum no. of figures possible = 51 × 2 = 102

Minimum no. of figures possible = 51 × 0 = 0

So, S1 alone is not sufficient to know if there are more than 100 figures in that book

**S2 : There is at least one figure on every page.**

Here, number of pages is not given. 

So, S2 alone is not sufficient to know if there are more than 100 figures in that book

**If we combine both the statements then we have 51 pages in the book with at least one figure and at most 2 figures on each page.**

Maximum no. of figures possible = 51 × 2 = 102

Minimum no. of figures possible = 51 × 1 = 51

51 < 100 < 102

Still we cannot answer if there are more than 100 figures in that book.

Hence, **"S1 and S2 together are not sufficient to answer the Question"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: The traffic lights at 3 different road crossings change after every 48 sec, 72 sec and 108 sec respectively. If they all change simultaneously at 8:20 am, then what time they will again change simultaneously ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The lights will change simultaneously after an interval equal to the LCM of their individual times.

LCM of 48, 72, and 108 = 432 seconds.

Converting to minutes: 432 seconds = 7 minutes and 12 seconds.

Next simultaneous change = 8:20:00 am + 7 min 12 sec = 8:27:12 am.

**∴ The correct answer is 8:27:12 am.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Traffic light 1 interval = 48 sec

Traffic light 2 interval = 72 sec

Traffic light 3 interval = 108 sec

Time of first simultaneous change = 8:20:00 am

**Formula Used:**

Next simultaneous change = Initial time + LCM(t₁, t₂, t₃)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Prime factorization of 48 = 2⁴ × 3

⇒ Prime factorization of 72 = 2³ × 3²

⇒ Prime factorization of 108 = 2² × 3³

⇒ LCM(48, 72, 108) = 2⁴ × 3³

⇒ LCM = 16 × 27 = 432 seconds

⇒ Convert 432 seconds into minutes = 432 ÷ 60

⇒ 432 seconds = 7 minutes and 12 seconds

⇒ Adding this interval to the initial given time:

⇒ Next change time = 8:20:00 am + 00:07:12

⇒ Next change time = 8:27:12 am

**∴ The correct answer is 8:27:12 am.**

Least Common Multiple (LCM)

The smallest multiple that is exactly divisible by every member of a set of numbers. It is primarily used to determine when multiple periodic events will synchronize and happen together again.

Highest Common Factor (HCF)

The largest positive integer that divides all the given numbers without leaving a remainder. It is commonly used for dividing different quantities into the largest possible equal groups.

Relationship between LCM and HCF

For any two specific numbers a and b, the product of the numbers is strictly equal to the product of their LCM and HCF: a × b = LCM(a, b) × HCF(a, b).

questions.question: If α and β are the roots of x² - 5x + 3 = 0, then a quadratic equation whose roots are α² and β² is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

From the **quadratic equation** x² − 5x + 3 = 0, the sum of roots α + β = 5 and product αβ = 3.

New sum of roots (S) = α² + β² = (α + β)² − 2αβ = 5² − 2(3) = 19.

New product of roots (P) = α²β² = (αβ)² = 3² = 9.

The required equation is x² − Sx + P = 0 ⇒ x² − 19x + 9 = 0.

**∴ The correct answer is x² − 19x + 9 = 0.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** α and β are the roots of the equation x² − 5x + 3 = 0.

**Formula Used:** For any quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0, the sum of roots = −b/a and the product of roots = c/a. A quadratic equation with roots r₁ and r₂ is given by x² − (r₁ + r₂)x + (r₁ × r₂) = 0.

**Calculations:**

⇒ For x² − 5x + 3 = 0: a = 1, b = −5, c = 3.

⇒ Sum of roots, (α + β) = −(−5)/1 = 5

⇒ Product of roots, (αβ) = 3/1 = 3

⇒ We need an equation with roots α² and β².

⇒ Sum of new roots = α² + β²

⇒ α² + β² = (α + β)² − 2αβ

⇒ Sum of new roots = (5)² − 2(3) = 25 − 6 = 19

⇒ Product of new roots = α² × β² = (αβ)²

⇒ Product of new roots = (3)² = 9

⇒ Forming the new quadratic equation: x² − (19)x + 9 = 0

⇒ x² − 19x + 9 = 0

**∴ The correct answer is x² − 19x + 9 = 0.**

**__Additional Information__**

Relation between Roots and Coefficients

For ax² + bx + c = 0, Sum = −b/a and Product = c/a. These values are essential for transforming roots into new equations.

Nature of Roots

The discriminant D = b² − 4ac determines the nature. If D > 0, roots are real and distinct; if D = 0, roots are real and equal; if D < 0, roots are complex.

Formation of Quadratic Equation

A general quadratic equation is written as x² − (Sum of roots)x + (Product of roots) = 0.

Algebraic Identities for Roots

Commonly used identities: α² + β² = (α + β)² − 2αβ and α³ + β³ = (α + β)((α + β)² − 3αβ).</p

questions.question: If the radius of the base of a right circular cylinder is halved, then keeping the height same, the ratio of the volume of the reduced cylinder to the volume of the original cylinder is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The **Volume** of a **cylinder** is proportional to the square of its **radius** (V ∝ r²) when **height** (h) is constant.

Since the radius is **halved**, the ratio of radii is 1 ÷ 2.

Therefore, the ratio of their volumes = (1)² ÷ (2)² = 1 ÷ 4.

**∴ The correct answer is 1 ∶ 4.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Original **Radius** = r

Reduced **Radius** = r ÷ 2

**Height** = h (remains same)

**Formula Used:**

Volume of **Right Circular Cylinder** = πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c289540bed7b6aef257f1058143c4fcea2fa48c585e664d6f157c68eb76d0475.png] 

⇒ Volume of Original Cylinder (V₁) = π × r² × h

⇒ Volume of Reduced Cylinder (V₂) = π × (r ÷ 2)² × h

⇒ V₂ = π × (r² ÷ 4) × h

⇒ Ratio (V₂ ÷ V₁) = [π × (r² ÷ 4) × h] ÷ [π × r² × h]

⇒ Ratio = (1 ÷ 4) ÷ 1 = 1 ÷ 4

**∴ The correct answer is 1 ∶ 4.**

**__Additional Information__**

Volume Proportionality

For a cylinder, the **Volume** varies directly with the **Height** and with the **Square of the Radius**. If only height is changed by factor k, volume changes by k. If only radius is changed by factor k, volume changes by k².

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

The **Curved Surface Area** of a cylinder is 2πrh. If the radius is halved and height remains same, the **CSA** is also halved (Ratio 1 ÷ 2).

Total Surface Area (TSA)

The **Total Surface Area** is given by 2πr(r + h), which includes the area of the two circular bases (2 × πr²) and the curved surface area.

questions.question: In hydropower plants, which energy of water is utilised to generate electricity?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __Potential energy__.

__
 
• Hydropower plants convert **potential energy** into **mechanical energy** through water turbines, which then generate electricity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Water stored in a dam possesses Potential energy.
 
• Either potential energy is a form of energy that results from an object's position or arrangement of parts.
 
• It is stored energy that can become kinetic energy.
 
• The measurement of the potential energy of an object is calculated based on the object's mass and its height or distance.
 
• P.E = mgh
 
• Where
 
 
• m = mass of the body, g = acceleration due to gravity, h = height 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• When this water is allowed to flow down from a height, the potential energy of water gets converted into **kinetic energy.**
 
• A hydraulic turbine thus converts the energy of this flowing water into mechanical energy.
 
• A hydroelectric generator converts this mechanical energy into electricity.

questions.question: The profit earned when an article is sold for Rs. 800 is 20 times the loss incurred when it is sold for Rs. 275. At what price should the article be sold if it is desired to make a profit of 25%.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Profit to Loss = 20 : 1.

Total difference in SP = 800 − 275 = Rs. 525.

Value of 21 parts (Total Gap) = 525 ⇒ 1 part (Loss) = 525 ÷ 21 = Rs. 25.

Cost Price = Lower SP + Loss = 275 + 25 = Rs. 300.

New Selling Price for 25% profit = 300 × (125 ÷ 100) = Rs. 375.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 375.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling Price 1 (SP₁) = Rs. 275 (sold at a loss)

Selling Price 2 (SP₂) = Rs. 800 (sold at a profit)

Profit obtained = 20 × Loss incurred

**Formula Used:**

Loss = Cost Price (CP) − Selling Price

Profit = Selling Price − Cost Price (CP)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6e65797bc85e6644f0a7255df63ea17be0a2c53f1f415a085c079176ac1c0e0.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Profit at SP₂ = 20 × Loss at SP₁

⇒ 800 − CP = 20 × (CP − 275)

⇒ 800 − CP = 20CP − 5500

⇒ 20CP + CP = 800 + 5500

⇒ 21CP = 6300

⇒ CP = 6300 ÷ 21 = Rs. 300

⇒ To make a 25% profit, the new selling price must be 125% of the Cost Price.

⇒ New Selling Price = CP × (100 + Profit%) ÷ 100

⇒ New Selling Price = 300 × (125 ÷ 100)

⇒ New Selling Price = 300 × 1.25 = Rs. 375

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 375.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price & Discount

Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price (MP) of an article. The fundamental formula is: Discount % = (Discount ÷ MP) × 100.

Successive Discounts

If two successive discounts of a% and b% are given, the equivalent single discount percentage is calculated as: a + b − (a × b ÷ 100).

Dishonest Dealer

questions.question: A swimmer, whose speed in 15 km/h in still water goes 30 km downstream and comes back. He takes 4 hours 30 minutes for the whole journey. What is the speed of the stream, in km/h?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Test the given options for **stream speed (v)** where Total Time = 30 / (15 + v) + 30 / (15 − v) = 4.5 hours.

If **v = 5**: Downstream time = 30 / (15 + 5) = 1.5 hours.

Upstream time = 30 / (15 − 5) = 3 hours.

Total time = 1.5 + 3 = **4.5 hours** (which is 4 hr 30 min).

**∴ The correct answer is 5 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of swimmer in **still water** (u) = 15 km/h

Total **distance** (D) = 30 km one way

Total **time taken** (T) = 4 hr 30 min = 4.5 hours

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e841bddaa4891f2dcb4b53f88a17726e7589708086a03c0eb84e51112774335.png] 

Let the speed of the **stream** be v km/h.

⇒ Downstream speed = (15 + v) km/h

⇒ Upstream speed = (15 − v) km/h

According to the question:

⇒ 30 / (15 + v) + 30 / (15 − v) = 4.5

⇒ 30 × [(15 − v + 15 + v) / (15² − v²)] = 4.5

⇒ 30 × [30 / (225 − v²)] = 4.5

⇒ 900 / (225 − v²) = 4.5

⇒ 225 − v² = 900 / 4.5

⇒ 225 − v² = 200

⇒ v² = 225 − 200 = 25

⇒ v = √25 = 5 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 5 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Downstream and Upstream Speed

If speed of boat is u and stream is v, then Downstream = u + v and Upstream = u − v.

Still Water Speed Formula

Speed in still water (u) = 1/2 × (Downstream Speed + Upstream Speed).

Stream Speed Formula

Speed of stream (v) = 1/2 × (Downstream Speed − Upstream Speed).

Average Speed for Round Trip

Average speed when distance is constant = (u² − v²) / u.</p

questions.question: What is that greatest four-digit number which when divided by 3 and 4 leaves remainder 2 in each case?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

LCM of divisors (3, 4) = 12.

Largest 4-digit number divisible by 12 is 9996.

Required number = (Largest number divisible by 12) + Remainder.

Required number = 9996 + 2 = 9998.

**∴ The correct answer is 9998.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given: Divisors = 3 and 4, Remainder in each case = 2.

Formula: Number = [LCM(Divisors) × k] + Remainder.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f537dce4f75253a0ac5a690f64f9b27b23cfa01770d157fe273a5c1fba1ffee7.png] 

⇒ Step 1: Find LCM of 3 and 4.

⇒ LCM(3, 4) = 12.

⇒ Step 2: Divide the greatest 4-digit number (9999) by 12 to find the remainder.

⇒ 9999 ÷ 12 = 833 with a remainder of 3.

⇒ Step 3: Find the greatest 4-digit number exactly divisible by 12.

⇒ 9999 − 3 = 9996.

⇒ Step 4: Add the common remainder 2 to this value.

⇒ 9996 + 2 = 9998.

**∴ The correct answer is 9998.**

**__Additional Information__**

General Form for Same Remainder

Any number that leaves a remainder 'r' when divided by x, y, and z is of the form: [LCM(x, y, z) × k] + r, where k is an integer.

LCM and HCF Relationship

Expression: 27 - [5 - {6 + 2(7 - (8 - 5))}]

Simplify expressions using BODMAS (Brackets, Orders, Division/Multiplication, Addition/Subtraction).

8 - 5 = 3

Expression becomes: 27 - [5 - {6 + 2(7 - 3)}]

Simplify the next brackets:

7 - 3 = 4

Expression becomes: 27 - [5 - {6 + 2 × 4}]

Perform multiplication:

2 × 4 = 8

Expression becomes: 27 - [5 - {6 + 8}]

Simplify the curly brackets:

6 + 8 = 14

Expression becomes: 27 - [5 - 14]

Simplify the square brackets:

5 - 14 = -9

Expression becomes: 27 - (-9)

Simplify the remaining subtraction:

27 - (-9) = 27 + 9 = 36

**∴ The simplified value is 36.**

questions.question: Meena buys 20 eggs at Rs. 7 and sells them at Rs. 7.20 per dozen. If the profit is Rs. 30, the number of eggs bought by her is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

LCM of 20 and 12 = 60 **eggs**.

**Cost Price (CP)** of 60 eggs = 3 × ₹7 = ₹21.

**Selling Price (SP)** of 60 eggs = 5 × ₹7.20 = ₹36.

**Profit** earned on 60 eggs = ₹36 − ₹21 = ₹15.

Since ₹15 profit is on 60 eggs, ₹30 profit will be on (60 ÷ 15) × 30 = 120 eggs.

**∴ The correct answer is 120 eggs.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Cost Price (CP)** of 20 eggs = ₹7

**Selling Price (SP)** of 12 eggs = ₹7.20

Total **Profit** earned = ₹30

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c19cb34d5961857da51b283c8c986fe7bb230d68168a63bf2f75c2ed58695568.png] 

**Formula:** **Profit** = Selling Price (SP) − Cost Price (CP)

⇒ CP of 1 egg = 7 ÷ 20 = ₹0.35

⇒ SP of 1 egg = 7.20 ÷ 12 = ₹0.60

⇒ Profit earned on 1 egg = 0.60 − 0.35 = ₹0.25

⇒ Let the number of **eggs** bought be 'n'.

⇒ Total Profit = n × Profit per egg

⇒ 30 = n × 0.25

⇒ n = 30 ÷ 0.25

⇒ n = 3000 ÷ 25

⇒ n = 120

Thus, the total number of eggs bought by Meena is 120, which corresponds to **Option (2)**.

**∴ The correct answer is 120 eggs.**

**__Additional Information__**

Unitary Method in Profit & Loss

Always calculate the CP and SP for a single unit to simplify calculations when quantities for buying and selling are different.

Profit Percentage Formula

Profit % = (Profit ÷ Cost Price) × 100. In this case, Profit % = (0.25 ÷ 0.35) × 100 ≈ 71.42%.

Relationship between CP, SP and Profit

If SP > CP, it is a Profit. If CP > SP, it is a Loss. Total Profit = Quantity × (SP per unit − CP per unit).

questions.question: The ratio of three numbers is 2 ∶ 3 ∶ 6 and the sum of their square is 441. What is the value of the largest of the three numbers?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of numbers = 2 : 3 : 6

Sum of squares of ratio parts = 2² + 3² + 6² = 4 + 9 + 36 = 49 units

Value of 1 unit² = 441 ÷ 49 = 9 ⇒ 1 unit = √9 = 3

Largest number = 6 units = 6 × 3 = 18

**∴ The correct answer is 18.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Ratio of **three numbers** = 2 : 3 : 6 and **Sum of squares** = 441.

**Formula Used:** Let the numbers be 2x, 3x, and 6x.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9bd67eed2766bce6ccc65d2188b7e36639d132790b3845e56c501ed94ca9332.png] 

⇒ (2x)² + (3x)² + (6x)² = 441

⇒ 4x² + 9x² + 36x² = 441

⇒ 49x² = 441

⇒ x² = 441 ÷ 49

⇒ x² = 9

⇒ x = 3

⇒ Largest number = 6x = 6 × 3 = 18

**∴ The correct answer is 18.**

**__Additional Information__**

Ratio and Squares

When values are in ratio a:b:c and their squares are summed, always include the variable x because the sum involves x², which requires taking a square root at the end.

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is given by √(a × b).

Compound Ratio

The compound ratio of (a : b) and (c : d) is (ac : bd).</p

questions.question: What is the primary function of the ILSA (Instrument for Lunar Seismic Activity) payload attached to the Chandrayaan-3 lander?
questions.solution:
The Correct answer is __**To measure lunar seismic activity (moonquakes)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Instrument for Lunar Seismic Activity (ILSA)** is one of the payloads attached to the Chandrayaan-3 lander.
 
• It is specifically designed to measure **lunar seismic activity**, commonly referred to as **moonquakes**.
 
• This instrument uses advanced **micro-electro-mechanical systems (MEMS)**-based technology to detect minute ground vibrations caused by seismic events.
 
• ILSA helps in studying the **internal structure of the Moon** by analyzing the seismic waves generated during moonquakes or impacts caused by celestial objects.
 
• The data collected by ILSA is crucial for understanding the Moon's **tectonic activity** and its **evolutionary history**.
 
• The payload contributes to assessing the potential risks of seismic activity in future **lunar habitation projects**.
 
• The integration of such an advanced payload underlines **India's technological capabilities** in planetary exploration through its **Chandrayaan missions**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **To measure lunar temperature**__

 __
 
• The measurement of **lunar temperature** is typically carried out using instruments like **thermal sensors** or radiometers.
 
• For example, Chandrayaan-3's lander payload **ChaSTE** (Chandra’s Surface Thermophysical Experiment) is responsible for measuring the Moon’s thermal properties.
 
 
 
• **To analyze soil chemistry**__
 __
 
• The analysis of **lunar soil chemistry** is performed to determine its **composition**, including the presence of elements like oxygen, silicon, and metals.
 
• In Chandrayaan-3, the **APXS (Alpha Particle X-ray Spectrometer)** and **LIBS (Laser Induced Breakdown Spectroscope)** are used for such purposes.
 
 
 
• **To capture high-resolution images**__
 
 
• Capturing **high-resolution images** is important for mapping the lunar surface and identifying potential landing sites.
 
• In Chandrayaan-3, the lander and rover are equipped with cameras like the **Laser Doppler Velocimeter** for navigation and imaging.

questions.question: PQRS is a cyclic quadrilateral In PQRS ∠P is opposite to ∠R. If ∠P and ∠R are 3x + 5 and 4x respectively, then what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a **cyclic quadrilateral**, the sum of **opposite angles** is always 180°.

Given: ∠P + ∠R = 180°

⇒ (3x + 5) + 4x = 180

⇒ 7x + 5 = 180

⇒ 7x = 175

⇒ x = 25

**∴ The correct answer is 25 degree.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

∠P = 3x + 5

∠R = 4x

Quadrilateral PQRS is **cyclic**, where P and R are **opposite vertices**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/433e6eaf7b464fdf7644f7bbe69261fdc3a75e3c83fe35a0470096297595311c.png] 

According to the **Cyclic Quadrilateral Theorem**, the sum of either pair of **opposite angles** is 180°.

⇒ ∠P + ∠R = 180°

⇒ (3x + 5) + 4x = 180

⇒ 7x + 5 = 180

⇒ 7x = 180 − 5

⇒ 7x = 175

⇒ x = 175 ÷ 7

⇒ x = 25

**∴ The correct answer is 25 degree.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cyclic Quadrilateral Property

A quadrilateral is cyclic if and only if its vertices lie on a circle, and its opposite angles sum to 180°.

Exterior Angle Property

The exterior angle of a cyclic quadrilateral is equal to the interior opposite angle.

Ptolemy's Theorem

For a cyclic quadrilateral, the product of the diagonals is equal to the sum of the products of the opposite sides: (PQ × RS) + (QR × PS) = PR × QS.</p
